extDesc.message: Organize your notebooks with custom tags and advanced filtering.

modal_delete_confirm_msg.message: Are you sure you want to delete the tag "$1"? This action cannot be undone and it will be removed from all your notebooks.

alert_collision_msg.message:
There are multiple notebooks with identical name, sources, and date in this list.

To avoid errors, rename one of the notebooks or use the thumbnail view to tag them.

import_granular_msg.message: Select the elements you want to overwrite from the selected file:

import_success_msg.message: The selected elements have been updated.

import_error_format_msg.message: The file does not appear to be a valid NBLM Organizer backup.

import_error_read_msg.message: The JSON file could not be processed correctly.

dev_mode_warning_msg.message: Your custom tags and notebook tagging could be deleted from your Google account if you uninstall the extension from all your devices. Use the export button (top right) to make periodic backups of your configuration.

conflict_msg.message: The cloud configuration is very different from the one saved on this device. This usually happens after an uninstallation or a massive cleanup. Which version do you want to keep?

sync_mode_off_tooltip.message: Disables the local security net. Behaves like an official extension, relying exclusively on Google Sync (risk of loss when uninstalling in dev mode).

sync_mode_heuristic_tooltip.message: Protection activates if you have at least 3 local tags and a loss of more than 50% of cloud data is detected (e.g., after an accidental uninstallation).

sync_mode_always_tooltip.message: Launches the comparative dialog whenever any difference is detected between this device and the cloud at startup.

dev_mode_warning_main_msg.message: In this mode, uninstalling the extension will delete ALL your tags from your Google account. You MUST export your configuration (export button) before uninstalling.

modal_delete_affects_one.message: It will be removed from 1 notebook.

modal_delete_affects_other.message: It will be removed from $1 notebooks.

error_tag_exists.message: A tag with that name already exists.

selection_hint.message: Click to select · Shift+click for a range · Esc to exit

selection_collision_msg.message: This notebook cannot be selected because it has the same fingerprint as another one (name and number of sources). Select it from the grid view.

modal_priority_on.message: Priority tag: shown first on notebooks. Among several priority tags, the order in which they were assigned to each notebook is kept (click to remove)

modal_priority_off.message: Mark as priority: it will be shown first on notebooks. Among several priority tags, the order in which they were assigned to each notebook is kept

storage_meter_help.message: Chrome Sync space used by your tags and their assignment to notebooks. Chrome allows about 100 KB per extension; once full, changes stop syncing.

storage_warning.message: Synced storage is at $1%. Once full, changes will stop syncing.

sync_error.message: Your latest changes could not be synced (storage full or Chrome Sync error). Export a backup so you do not lose them.
